description: This file defines a configuration class for the Fal AI Imagen4 image generation model, including methods to map parameters, transform requests, and process responses. It is part of a larger project related to image generation with AI models.

classes.name: FalAIImagen4Config
classes.description: Configuration class for the Fal AI Imagen4 image generation model, including parameter mapping, request transformation, and response processing methods.

methods.name: List[OpenAIImageGenerationOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Imagen4-specific parameters, optionally dropping unsupported parameters.

methods.name: str _map_aspect_ratio(self, size: str)
methods.description: Converts OpenAI size parameters to Imagen4 aspect ratio strings, either through predefined mappings or by analyzing width/height ratios.
